question: Can an LLM do 3D modeling you can print?

hook_visual.intent: a prompt becoming short code, and that code becoming a printable object

points.claim: sand3d is a Python library for writing 3D objects as short programs over Blender's bpy module.
points.spoken: It's a Python library that writes three-dimensional objects as short programs on top of Blender.
points.source_note: README: 'sand3d is a Python library for writing 3D objects as short programs: profiles, solids, edits, frames, joints and assemblies, over Blender's bpy.'

visual.intent: python lines building a named part in Blender

points.title: Parts as programs

points.claim: A part takes two to six times fewer tokens than in Blender Python or CadQuery, and the whole API fits in a prompt.
points.spoken: A part takes two to six times fewer tokens than the same part in Blender Python or CadQuery, and the whole API fits in a prompt.
points.source_note: README: 'Short. A part takes 2 to 6× fewer tokens than the same part in Blender Python, CadQuery or FeatureScript'; 'The whole API fits in a prompt, about 3,600 tokens'.

visual.intent: the token count falling and the API fitting in one prompt

points.title: Small enough for a prompt

points.claim: Parts, edges and faces are reached by name, and the same program builds the same mesh every time.
points.spoken: Every part, edge and face is reached by name, and the same program builds the same mesh every time.
points.source_note: README: 'Named, not computed. Parts, edges and faces are reached by name, never by hand-computed coordinates.'; 'Deterministic. The same program builds the same mesh, bit for bit.'

visual.intent: named parts and a repeatable build

points.title: Named, and repeatable

points.claim: One call exports GLB, URDF, USD, OBJ or STL, and the washing machine example is 38 lines with four joints.
points.spoken: It exports GLB, URDF, USD, OBJ or STL, and a washing machine example is thirty-eight lines with four joints.
points.source_note: README: 'Export: GLB, URDF, USD, OBJ, STL'; 'A front-loading washing machine in 38 lines of code'; 'four joints that say how they move'.

visual.intent: the export formats and the jointed washing machine example

points.title: Straight to a file
points.sub: GLB, URDF, USD, OBJ or STL.

catch: The catch: it needs Blender's bpy module, which only ships for certain Python versions, so check yours first.
catch_sub: bpy has no wheel for every Python or Intel Mac.

catch_visual.intent: the Python versions bpy supports and the Intel Mac exception

cover.visual: designed graphic of Python lines turning into an isometric part with named faces
